NDIS workers just won one of the biggest wage justice campaigns in years.
Now all disability support workers will be paid as disability support workers, like they always should have been. Because together we said no more dodgy providers skimming wages. We stood in solidarity and won. And we’re just getting started.

Today we are calling for the end of community and disability workers being undervalued and underpaid for far too long. 

We are the backbone of our communities and it is time our pay and government funding reflect that. 

Read the full article via the link in our bio.

Today ASU members have won a 4.75% pay rise for nearly 3 million workers from 1 July 2026. 

Together, we campaigned to make sure that every worker is paid enough to cover the bills and enjoy life outside of work. And together, we've won it. 

Head to the link in our bio to find out what 4.75% means for your pay from July 1.
Qantas profits are soaring, yet the Company is eyeing off offshoring 1000 jobs. Aussie workers deserve better. We won't stand by while jobs are put at risk. Sign the petition via the link in our bio

If you're paid under an Award, your 4.75% pay rise kicked in from July 1! As well as Payday Super for all workers. Have you been checking your payslips? 👀
